title: Case: Freight collection needs confirmed pallet dimensions and weight
context: Freight allocation is paused because pallet dimensions and weight are missing. The shipper must provide measured values before the planner allocates a vehicle.
initial_request: We have the pallet ready. Please tell me which measurements the carrier needs to finish the booking.

events.from: Freight booking desk, Foxhallow Arc Logistics
events.body: DL-3436 has one pallet at Nettlebank Span Fabrication, but its dimensions and weight fields are blank. We cannot allocate a collection vehicle from an unspecified pallet size.

events.from: Gideon Quarrie, Nettlebank Span shipping coordinator
events.body: We have the pallet ready. Please tell me which measurements the carrier needs to finish the booking.

events.from: Gideon Quarrie, Nettlebank Span shipping coordinator
events.body: We have the pallet ready. Please tell me which measurements the carrier needs to finish the booking.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Gideon Quarrie, Nettlebank Span shipping coordinator
acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the shipper for measured dimensions and weight before carrier allocation.

must_not: Customer measurements are not an independent carrier weighing; allocation is not collection.
Treats the repeated copy of the request as a second, separate request (for example by sending two requests to the same team)
expected.reference_message: Please provide measured length, width and total height including pallet, plus gross weight including packaging, for DL-3436. We will pass those actual measurements to the carrier.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-043: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. The escalation message arrives twice; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
